name: v2-106cdd09-blind30-ots
instr:
# Miniflux: thirty silent regressions across the server and its Go bindings, to be diagnosed without a test suite

This is a self-hosted server that collects articles from the sites someone follows and hands them to its own pages, to apps talking to it over the network, and to a bundled library that other programs are written against. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. Nothing about the protocols, the stored data or the callers changed, yet operations that used to work now come back wrong, and in several places something that used to be accepted is refused while something that should be refused goes quietly through.

Driving the server from another program through the bundled library has gone quiet in four places. Asking for the per-source read and unread tallies hands back an empty result and no error at all, even though the server answered with the numbers. Creating an account returns an empty record instead of the account that was stored, and modifying an account likewise returns nothing rather than the changed record. Listing the sources filed under one category comes back empty too, although the call goes to the right address with the right method.

Adding a new source misbehaves from the first step onward. Asking the server to find sources at an ordinary web address carrying a secure scheme now fails with an error even when nothing else was supplied alongside it, while an address with no scheme at all is still refused as before. Offering candida
